title: Giraffe eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='24' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='68' r='3.2' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='66' r='3.6' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='70' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='77' r='3.4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='78' r='2.8' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='24' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='24' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='35' y='83' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='35' y='83' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='48' y='83' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f5c542'/>

  <rect x='58' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <line x1='66' y1='68' x2='76' y2='62' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='61' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M55 64 Q62 40 66 24 L76 26 Q72 44 64 66 Z' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <path d='M55 64 Q62 40 66 24 L76 26 Q72 44 64 66 Z' fill='none' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='52' r='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='3.2' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='33' r='2.8' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='20' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#f5c542'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='20' rx='12' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <line x1='67' y1='13' x2='65' y2='5' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='4' r='2.6' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='13' x2='78' y2='5' stroke='#e0a82a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='4' r='2.6' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='16' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8b53a' transform='rotate(-25 61 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='16' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8b53a' transform='rotate(25 83 16)'/>

  <circle cx='75' cy='18' r='2.2' fill='#4a3010'/>
  <circle cx='75.7' cy='17.3' r='0.8' fill='#fff6d8'/>

  <ellipse cx='83' cy='23' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f0b860'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='22' r='0.9' fill='#8a5a1a'/>
  <!-- mouth notch -->
  <path d='M82 24 Q84 26 86 24' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a1a' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf snack -->
  <path d='M88 25 Q95 22 96 15 Q90 16 88 25 Z' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <path d='M88 25 Q91 20 95 16' fill='none' stroke='#8fe08f' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <path d='M88 25 Q92 26 97 24 Q94 29 88 25 Z' fill='#66bb6a'/>
  <!-- bite mark on leaf -->
  <circle cx='93' cy='19' r='2' fill='#f5c542' opacity='0.9'/>
